phase_name: Re-key the Double-Loading Check in the source script

objectives.description: Replace the Double-Loading Check section and comment block
Add live route derivation (never hardcoded agent names)
Define direct-command roster and /orchestrate special case
Implement three-bucket partition and reporting, promote redundant to VIOLATIONS
Rewrite comment block with criterion/exemption/coverage boundary
Update WARNINGS/EXCEPTIONS_APPLIED separation comment at top of file

notes: bash -n parses clean. shellcheck not available in this environment (acceptable per plan's conditional wording). grep confirms no literal agent name in the new section's code (only pre-existing budget-cap table entries elsewhere in the file).

Added env-var overrides (VALIDATE_BUDGETS_MANIFEST_OVERRIDE, VALIDATE_BUDGETS_META_SKILL_OVERRIDE, VALIDATE_BUDGETS_SPAWN_SKILL_OVERRIDE, VALIDATE_BUDGETS_REVISE_SKILL_OVERRIDE), unset in normal operation, so Phase 5's degraded-derivation test case can stub an unreadable route source against the real deployed script without touching real deployed files.
Behavioral verification (running the deployed copy) deferred to Phase 4 per the plan's dependency graph -- deploy-root-guard.sh blocks execution from the source store.

Addendum discovered during Phase 5 test authoring (two bugs fixed in this same file, re-verified against Phase 4's already-passing 0/13/0 result with no change to that outcome): (1) a degraded (empty-string) route was originally represented as an empty array in the route table, which made the redundancy subset test vacuously true for an unroutable command instead of routing it to unclassifiable -- fixed by omitting degraded routes from the table entirely so `$route_table[$c] // null` resolves to null for them; (2) the route-derivation helper pipelines propagated jq's non-zero exit through pipefail into the enclosing command substitution, aborting the whole script under set -e on a missing manifest instead of degrading gracefully -- fixed with `|| true` on each pipeline. See phase-5-progress.json and the plan's Phase 5 task list for the full detail.
